entries.summary: 1. Persist the source record before publishing any packet. 2. Freeze duplicate meaning key, request hash, and idempotency key on the outbox side source truth. 3. Treat broker deli…
entries.searchText: outbox inbox and idempotency runbook core rules docs/messaging/outbox runbook.md 1. persist the source record before publishing any packet. 2. freeze duplicate meaning key request hash on side truth. 3. treat broker delivery as rebuildable transport. packet ids counters queue history are never authoritative 4. run durable dedupe continuity checks mutation. 5. dead letter or quarantine after safe retries exhausted. do not loop blindly.

entries.searchText: outbox inbox and idempotency runbook identity posture docs/messaging/outbox runbook.md duplicate meaning key: retry reconciliation bucket for the same business meaning. request hash: exact sealed send identity. durable that survives lawful resend of authority traffic keeps those concepts separate on purpose. token rotation within one frozen binding lineage may change hash while preserving key key.

entries.searchText: outbox inbox and idempotency runbook redaction posture docs/messaging/outbox runbook.md packets rows observability traces may carry refs hashes reason codes safe routing hints. they not carry: raw secrets or token values plaintext authority request callback bodies signed urls inline blob content used as durable truth customer copied out of protected ledgers

entries.title: Outbox, Inbox, and Idempotency Runbook · Restore and Recovery
entries.summary: Recovery rebuilds outstanding work from durable source, outbox, inbox, ingress, interaction, and submission truth. Do not rebuild legal state by replaying broker history.
entries.searchText: outbox inbox and idempotency runbook restore recovery docs/messaging/outbox runbook.md rebuilds outstanding work from durable source ingress interaction submission truth. do not rebuild legal state by replaying broker history.

entries.searchText: outbox inbox and idempotency runbook retry dead letter posture docs/messaging/outbox runbook.md commands worker stage packets after bounded safe retries. authority request ingress quarantine retries because legal meaning or correlation may have drifted. redrive is lawful only when the same durable still holds.

entries.title: Outbox, Inbox, and Idempotency Runbook · Source-Record Continuity
